description: The image presents a 2x2 grid of four pie charts comparing the distribution of response categories for four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. There is no separate legend provided; instead, all category labels, raw counts, and percentages are positioned directly inside their respective slices. None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding, and the segments do not appear to follow a strict size-based ordering across all charts. The top-left chart for GPT4-o consists of two slices: a dominant red slice labeled "Lack of Knowledge" representing 5 (83.3%) and a light orange slice for "Safety" at 1 (16.7%). The top-right chart for Gemini1.5-Pro contains five slices: a light orange slice for "Misinformation" at 33 (38.4%), a dark blue slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 19 (22.1%), a light blue slice for "Ethical Advice" at 14 (16.3%), a pale yellow slice for "Clarification" at 12 (14.0%), and a red slice for "Safety" at 8 (9.3%). The bottom-left chart for Llama3.1-70B-Instruct features two slices: a light orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 3 (75.0%) and a red slice for "Clarification" at 1 (25.0%). Finally, the bottom-right chart for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct is divided into two equal slices: a red slice for "Misinformation" at 2 (50.0%) and a light orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 2 (50.0%).
